messages.subject: error message from learn
messages.body_plain:
When I attempt to run deal on a 16 continuous variables, 200 case
example I get the following error when I attempt to run learn():

a.nw <- getnetwork(learn(a.nw,a,a.prior))
Error in postc0c(node$condposterior[[1]]$mu,
node$condposterior[[1]]$tau,  : 
        NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 1)
Could someone tell me how to fix that?

The data do not contain any NA, although a.prior does (since there are
no discrete variables.

Thanks

Bill Raynor
